body:
Agent PR #326 merged with green CI but without being linked to Agent #322. Its description mentioned #322 only in a negated sentence. Local link detection read that sentence as a closing reference, so the link was never repaired. The merge gate also skipped ordinary (non-repository-mode) issues.

Fixes #2335

As [requested](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/2336#issuecomment-5948156787), this PR now covers only the links between issues and pull requests. The prompt, goal and requirements-evidence changes moved to #2406 and its stacked PR #2407.

## What changes

- **Parser.** One shared closing-reference parser serves detection, repair, discovery and continuation. It ignores HTML comments and code, skips negated clauses ("does not close …"), and matches exact repositories. A bare `#N` counts only for the PR's own repository. Diagnosis and batch discovery read the description instead of the title. Queue timeline discovery accepts only positive closing references.
- **Primary issue.** Continue mode takes the issue from the `issue-N-…` branch name first and never falls back to the PR number. While this PR was being continued, the deployed v2.33.2 resumed it as hive-mind #322 because of a quoted example in this description. That body is archived, and a regression test replays it.
- **Repair.** `pr-issue-link-repair.lib.mjs` adds one positive keyword for every required issue: the primary issue, nested native sub-issues and body-only references. It writes through a sanitized temp file that is always removed, reads the description back, and reports failures instead of claiming success. It runs after each working session, after description rewrites and after restarts.
- **Merge boundary.** `issue-link-verification.lib.mjs` re-reads the description right before every automated merge, including the merge queue. A missing reference blocks the merge. For default-branch merges, GitHub's own `closingIssuesReferences` (paginated) must confirm every link. Reads fail closed. Merges into non-default branches close the linked issues afterwards and report any close failures.
- **Repository mode.** All open issues stay in the required body list. Only native attachments are capped at 100. The test uses 105 issues.

## Reproduce and verify

```bash
node --test tests/issue-link-verification-2335.test.mjs   # 17 tests, including the PR #326 replay and the real mergePullRequest
node --test tests/issue-linking-2335.test.mjs
node experiments/issue-2335-pr2336-self-misdetection.mjs docs/case-studies/issue-2335/data/hive-mind-pr-2336-body-at-misroute.md  # prints 2335
node --max-old-space-size=256 experiments/issue-2335/verify-evidence.mjs
```

The merge-boundary test runs the actual `mergePullRequest` in a subprocess with a finite fake `gh`. With the body "Related to #322." it returns `missing_closing_references` and never calls `gh pr merge`. With "Fixes" plus the issue number, it merges. `issue-link-verification.lib.mjs` and `pr-issue-link-repair.lib.mjs` have 100% line, branch and function coverage.

Local checks on `7550f85b`: all 533 default test files pass, and lint, format, duplication, file-line limits, syntax and changeset validation pass. `main` is merged, including the #2395 pre-merge link gate, which now delegates to this check.

CI's dependency freshness gate failed on every branch, including `main`, after rust 1.99.0 and `@dotenvx/dotenvx` 2.32.4 were released. The last commit bumps those pins. The Formal AI dispatch test now checks for the bookworm (glibc 2.36) builder rather than a specific rust minor version.

The case study is at [`docs/case-studies/issue-2335`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2335-d92d19d37a1b/docs/case-studies/issue-2335/README.md). It includes the full incident capture, all 11 Agent CI logs and the timeline.

## Limits

A correctly linked PR can still be partial. Requiring evidence that every requirement is done is #2406 / #2407. A human can still merge outside hive-mind.
